d: Delhi is considering a scheme to encourage people to return used plastic bottles for recycling, taking a cue from Uttarakhand and Goa, where similar initiatives are already in place. Under the proposed scheme, consumers may have to pay an additional Re 1 or Rs 2 when buying a bottle and get the amount back when they return it at a designated collection point, The Indian Express has learnt. Srirupa Goswami asked the residents of Delhi about this proposal.
